_: Cinderscapes, from All of Fabric 3's census (W4 R6, judged 2026-11-11). Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw as ground and judged, because any word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. The ash layer and the wart blocks were not judged and are left to the rules.

Nether: umbral nylium is a nylium, the Nether's own ground by what it is, on a rock material the rules leave out for having no stone word. Sand: the ash block is loose fine ash, as BYG's subzero ash block was judged, though it lies in the Nether; its material is crafted snow's and detection gave it snow.
